overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation where the Board took up unlisted disposal permits and invoices, noting the matters were re-listed and re-voted at the September 20 meeting before the complaint was filed.

allegations.summary: Board allegedly discussed and voted on two disposal works permits and two invoices not on the Sept. 6 meeting notice and did not amend the notice.
allegations.key_passage: Although we encourage public bodies to amend meeting notices when an unanticipated topic arises that it wishes to discuss, the Open Meeting Law does not require that they do so.
